subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix, refresh one of the existing candidate branches, or wait for contributor follow-up?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but existing same-repository attempts are closed and the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr/needs-maintainer-review, so automation should not create another duplicate branch without a maintainer choosing the repair path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh focused fix
options.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed PRs only as context.

options.title: Refresh an existing candidate
options.body: Pick the best existing branch or fork, resolve conflicts, repair known review blockers, and require live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh focused fix
recommendation.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with tests and live Feishu proof, using the closed PRs only as context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path work and current blame make this the strongest routing signal for choosing the repair path.
